public_payload.normalized_proposition: Anthropic must reach its projected $174 billion in annual revenue by 2029 to pay for its compute commitments.
conditions: to pay for its compute commitments

statement.excerpt: To pay for this compute, Anthropic must meet its projected revenue of $174 billion a year by 2029.

our_interpretation: Read “by 2029” as no later than December 31, 2029.
Read annual revenue as revenue earned over a year, not an annualized monthly run rate.
The claim asserts that the revenue threshold is necessary to pay the commitments identified in the post.
The company projection is attributed to Anthropic, but its accounting conventions are not specified.
Paying the identified commitments is the conditional antecedent; signing them alone does not establish payment.
criteria.support_condition: Payment records and a complete cash-funding reconciliation establish that paying the identified compute obligations required at least USD 174 billion in annual revenue by the deadline.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Anthropic pays the identified obligations while remaining below USD 174 billion in annual revenue through the deadline, using other available resources, or binding payment and financing records establish that the threshold was unnecessary.
